alerts.descriptionText: INTERCHANGING TO BRENT CROSS SHOPPING CENTRE FROM BRENT CROSS STATION? Please note that the footbridge at Brent Cross Flyover is closed. Use the Heathfield Gardens exit and walk along Heathfield Gardens to the footbridge next to the railway line to access Brent Cross Shopping Centre. This exit is not step-free and closes at 2000 Monday to Saturday and all day Sunday. Bus route 210 operates during the day between Brent Cross Station and Brent Cross Shopping Centre.

alerts.headerText: Barons Court Underground Station Part Closure
alerts.descriptionText: BARONS COURT STATION: From Monday 6 July until November, westbound trains will not call at Barons Court. If travelling westbound from the station, please use eastbound District or Piccadilly line trains and change to westbound services at West Kensington (on the District line) or Earls Court (on the Piccadilly line) and change to westbound services. If travelling westbound to the station, please continue to Hammersmith and change for eastbound District or Piccadilly line trains.
